basics.label: Research Fellow
basics.summary: Research Fellow at the Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD). My research focuses on optimization for classical and quantum AI at the intersection of algorithmic game theory and Sum-of-Squares (SOS) optimization, with applications to learning and equilibration in strategic multi-agent systems and to training parameterized quantum circuits.
